title: RAID HUD TEXT KEEPS ITS I DOTS
why: UI step 1 of the HUD hierarchy job (103). No capital letter is drawn in a raid frame (every string goes through the lower case door), but at 1080p the small i of the condensed face lost its dot and read as a capital I (run Info, In cover, In chill row), which the critic and a player both take for a broken lower case order. The HUD canvas now draws unhinted text, which keeps the dot. The ammo card dip while the extraction ship is inbound goes from 60 to 70 percent (the critic: too faint). Watch: HUD letters look a touch softer; the i dots are visible; if the text looks worse to him, this one line (textRendering) is the one to undo.
now: Small i letters in the raid HUD show their dot again. The ammo card fades less while the extraction ship is coming.

edits.replacement: if(typeof G.beaconT==='number'&&G.beaconT>0) ctx.globalAlpha=0.7;   // v28.xx (cw-h103fix): the critic found 60 percent too faint to read the rounds, so 70;
